title: Government
description: Finland is governed as a parliamentary republic. The system of government shapes daily life through laws, services, and the citizen's relationship to the state. Its modern form dates to 1917 (independence) — and like all governments, it continues to evolve with its people.

title: Independence and statehood

title: Languages
description: Language in Finland: Finnish; Swedish co-official. Language carries the culture's humor, proverbs, and worldview — learning even greetings opens doors that stay closed to outsiders. Multilingual countries code-switch daily; visitors who try the local tongue are repaid with warmth.

title: Currency and money
